{"command": "cd /tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re, collections
rows=[]
with open('bodies.txt') as f:
    for line in f:
        parts=line.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
        if len(parts)<2: continue
        fn=parts[0]; body=parts[-1]
        d=dict(re.findall(r'([a-z]+)=([^&]*)', body))
        rows.append((fn,d))
# check keys across rows
keys=collections.Counter(tuple(sorted(d.keys())) for _,d in rows)
print(keys)
# duplicates in n
ns=[d.get('n','') for _,d in rows]
print('dup n:', [x for x,c in collections.Counter(ns).items() if c>1][:5])
# look at any field containing FLAG-like
for fn,d in rows:
    for k,v in d.items():
        if re.search(r'FLAG|flag|\{', v):
            print(fn,k,v[:200])
EOF"}

{"command": "cd /tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
from scapy.all import *
import re
pkts = rdpcap('/home/ctfplayer/ctf_files/cap.pcap')
streams = {}
for p in pkts:
    if TCP in p and Raw in p:
        payload = bytes(p[Raw].load)
        key = (p[IP].src, p[TCP].sport, p[IP].dst, p[TCP].dport)
        if p[TCP].dport == 8080:
            streams.setdefault(key, []).append((p[TCP].seq, payload))
print("client streams:", len(streams))
# write each stream's concatenated payload in seq order
import os
os.makedirs('streams', exist_ok=True)
for i,(k,segs) in enumerate(streams.items()):
    segs.sort()
    data = b''.join(s[1] for s in segs)
    open(f'streams/{i}.bin','wb').write(data)
lens = [(len(open(f'streams/{i}.bin','rb').read())) for i in range(len(streams))]
print(sorted(lens)[:10], sorted(lens)[-10:])
EOF", "timeout": 180}
